title: [finding] Two major-18 D3 entries print `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision … unchanged` through `os migrate meta`, which PR #20251 makes false in the same major
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, finding class **(b)**. The `reach:` exception is release text: `os migrate meta` prints these entries to authors, and protocol 18 is unreleased, so this is fixable before any release.

Found by the base-merge round on #19992 (PR #20251; report on this seat's session, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is false

PR #20251 retires `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` in major 18 (conversion `currency-config-precision-removed`, D3 `currency-config-precision-retired`). The maintainer approved it at `33f53b5e`, and it is armed. Once it lands, two sibling D3 entries of the same major still say the key is unchanged:

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.field-scale-precision-integer-refused.ts` (about :24–25): 「`CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` (under `currencyConfig`) is a different surface with its own bounds and alias table and is unchanged.」
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-form-field-precision-scale-integer-refused.ts` (about :29–30): 「⚠️ `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` and the gantt `scale` enum are different surfaces and are unchanged.」

## What the fix is (for the dispatch to confirm)

- Reword only the `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` clause in each entry: it is removed in this same major by `currency-config-precision-removed`. Put no tracker number in the field text.
- Keep the gantt `scale` clause, which is still true.
- Run `gen:migration-registry`, then `check:migration-registry`, `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` and `migrations.test.ts`. The fix is text only.
- Serial after PR #20251 lands. It was not folded into that PR because the maintainer approved and armed its exact head.

## Dedupe

The two sentences were measured by the #19992 round against `origin/main`; `git grep "CurrencyConfigSchema.precision" packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` gives exactly these 2 hits. No open card carries them: this is a sibling-text consequence of PR #20251, found in its round.

Dedupe words: `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision unchanged D3 entry` · `stale sibling retirement prose migrate meta`
